ascents.comment: She wasn't angry
Top one hundo for sure. Shogun Szn 1, Episode 2 had me steezin
Top 100
Soft second
Top one hundo outside of the dumpy first move
Soft second. Top is chill. @ me if you disagree

Late log solely due to the absolute depression that followed. Projected this earlier in the week and was jazzed to send first go. Probably the best V6 I've climbed to date. Unfortunately, the utter bliss was followed by a full A2 rupture and a couple months hiatus on a climb in left fork.
After chuffing the top two weeks ago on a lovely day out with Pinchious Maximimous, came back for revenge and put it down v fast.

Great day out with Davis and Ron. Started off trying Local Hole - also an underrated banger - and having chuffing off the top multiple times decided to visit an old nemesis down the road, Danos Arete. Admittedly, didn't reach my last high point on Danos and realized that it's a day of techy moves rather than trying to fry my shoulders/squeeze the life out of a classic arete climb. Ironically, I got locked in on another arete on the other side of the boulder that was giving me some trouble when I was here last year with Nedward. 

Honestly, overall thoughts on Momma Cat Arete, underrated. Really delicate movement and a good test of hip mobility on a fickle arete. Good climb if you're looking for a hot mod on the outer reaches of Tahoe.

Great day out with Nedward. Started the day at Kirkwood, and after dryfiring on the last hold on Ashy to Classy and the spot absolutely getting blown up, we embarked on a journey to Caples Lake. Tried Practical Demon Keeping, v fun but v delicate. Nedo gave some solid burns as we listened to "Itty Bitty" by Ashnikko, but no sends for the boys. Looking to get back on the high, Nedward flashed Head Hunting Sit and I flashed the stand. I looked at Nedo after topping out and said that it felt like V3 hoping that it would boost le confidance on the sit. It did not, and the bunchy high foot for the sit start was hard to establish to get the stand for the sit. I'm optimistic it'll go pretty quick next time. Ended the day on Arrowhead up the hill which felt like an insanely hard, 1 move wonder. 

The night concluded with burgers at Classic Cue. Always a good time hanging out with Johnny Sins' stunt double. To more epic day trips to South Lake.

First move is a pain in the ass but after you stick it, it's not too bad. Started off the day at Donner Summit trying Girls on Film sit. Frustration snuck in then tried to make up for it with Thunder Cat, which the non-send resulted in further frustration. In an attempt to keep the day moving and accomplish my goals for the season, I set my sights on a V4 I hadn't done before and viola, things came together quite quickly after I did the first move on this thing.
Nice flash to start the day thanks to Ned's beta sussing. Good moves. Might be easier than 7a if you're 5'7 and above. Really good climb and recommend making a trip to this lesser explored crag.
Great day out with Nedo. Goal was to put this one down for the day trip. Bagged it pretty quickly. Great climb but definitely more 7a or 7b. Just enough height to get the heart rate going as well.
Great day out with Ishmael. Not sure if the boys were on point with saying it's the best V5 in Coloradbro but it is a banger. No cap. Facts. Type shit.
Hot take, but toe hook makes it feel like V2. Tried Hunger Strike down the hill. Will go after 4 weeks of deadlifts.

Kinda a wild approach after a long day of driving. Pulled up on stabbing and sussed out the beta pretty quickly. Really please with how fast this went. Probably not bona fide V7 but someone did so I guess we take the points either way.

Came back to this block after it stifled me years ago. Tahoe just has so much good rock  that it's so hard to find a good balance between projecting and going to a new area. Really happy with the send of this one.
Nice little flash after repeatedly chuffing off of the first move of Globetrotter at Lake Audrain.
Really nice face climb. Actually thought it was much closer to 6C+ due to the tech involved.

Pretty pumped to put this thing down so quickly. First time I've worked and send 7B+ in a single session. 1 go from the bottom, pieced the moves, then two more with the eventual send. Great weekend out with the GWPC fam.
Really nice and underrated climb just past Castle. Great 3D movement and insanely roadside. Only downside is the constant gun fire from the gun range.
